study_identification.title: Judged by your neighbors: A novel framework for personalized assessment of brain structural aging effects in diverse populations

study_characteristics.study_objective: Introduce Nearest Neighbor Normativity (N^3) to provide individualized brain structural normativity assessments that disentangle inter-individual variability from pathological alterations, and benchmark against traditional z-score-based normative modeling and brain age across neurodegenerative cohorts.

dataset_name.reason: Training data for normative modeling drawn from a large, population-based cohort (NAKO).
dataset_name.supporting_text: The training data for fitting models of the different normative modeling approaches comprised 30,047 samples from the population-based NAKO cohort... We exclude age groups below 22 years and above 72 years... which restricts the final sample to 29,883.

hc_age.reason: Age range reported via exclusion criteria; mean and SD not reported.
hc_age.supporting_text: Exclusion criteria were applied based on age; participants younger than 22 years or older than 72 were omitted.

hc_sex.supporting_text: In our application to brain structure, we stratify the training sample by sex and age...

imaging_modality.supporting_text: All neuroimaging data utilized in this study were T1-weighted MRI scans from these baseline measurements.

modeling_method.reason: Methods explicitly define kNN-based local density estimation and meta-normativity aggregation.
modeling_method.supporting_text: The N^3 approach is based on local density estimation in tailored control groups... we use the simple and intuitive Nearest-Neighbor algorithm... We introduce context ... use the exponentiated Weibull distribution... The output ... the N^3 marker.

deviation_metric.answer: N^3 marker (meta-normativity score based on kNN local density across age/sex-tailored control groups). Comparators: NM-S (sum of |z|); NM-C (count of |z|>1.96); Brain Age Gap (BAG).
deviation_metric.reason: Paper defines the new deviation metric and describes comparator metrics.
deviation_metric.supporting_text: We evaluate the N^3 marker... Using classical normative modeling, we derive two normativity scores... sum of the absolute z-scores (NM-S)... number of z-scores whose magnitude deviates beyond a threshold of ±1.96 (NM-C)... benchmark against the Brain Age paradigm (BAG).

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Group-level ANOVA-style comparisons with partial eta squared (η^2) and F-statistics to assess explained variance between controls and disease groups; machine learning classification with cross-validation reporting balanced accuracy, F1-score, precision, and sensitivity to evaluate single-subject predictive utility.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: N^3 outperforms brain age and conventional z-score-based normative metrics in distinguishing AD and FTD and shows modest advantages for MCI; improves single-subject classification metrics across disorders.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Effect sizes: AD η^2=0.29; FTD η^2=0.38; MCI η^2=0.07 (vs. BAG η^2=0.05; normative z-score metrics η^2=0.02 for MCI). Single-subject classification: N^3 balanced accuracy exceeded second-best by +5.8% (AD) and +7.5% (FTD), +1.1% (MCI vs. BAG). Sensitivity gains of +1.6% (MCI), +11.0% (AD), +2.9% (FTD); highest F1 across conditions.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Performance depends on composition/size of the reference sample; no explicit handling of site/scanner effects or QC covariates reported; analyses limited to global volumetric measures; smaller effect sizes in MCI; some cohort demographics are only available in figures/tables.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: N^3 forms normativity profiles across the age continuum using sex- and age-tailored control groups and a two-layer kNN density estimation aggregated via an exponentiated Weibull; stability analysis shows ICC ≥0.75 with ~200+ per group and ≥0.9 with ~300+; code to be released (Python).

general_notes.general_notes: Datasets involved: NAKO (training), ADNI/AIBL/OASIS3/NIFD (evaluation), MACS (external HC for stability). Preprocessing via CAT12/SPM12 with explicit versions. MRI acquisition parameters summarized for cohorts (e.g., NAKO 3T MPRAGE; ADNI 1.5/3T MPRAGE; AIBL 3D MPRAGE). Preprint DOI indicates 2024; medRxiv posting noted 2025. Some numeric details (per-group Ns/ages/sex) appear only in tables/figures not available as text in the provided materials.
